title: Disclosure "Scriptability

scopes.description: Complete current author-documented workflow; the datasheet provides the manual construction recipe and the online appendix provides current measure definitions and validation analyses. The package does not include complete executable Python/R or empirical-analysis entry points; its R console history is only a partial code artifact.

requirements.description: Author-prepared filing-level scriptability measures used in the study. The supplied file includes accessionNumber, CIK, FileDate, formgroup, component ranks, IdentifyData and DataToInformation. The current appendix defines CompScript as their average; that summary column is not present in the probed header. The probe establishes readability and required source columns only, not complete history/population coverage.

routes.description: The README names this exact compressed CSV as containing all scriptability data used in the study. A bounded gzip/CSV probe read the header and first record and found the documented filing identifiers, form group, component fields, IdentifyData and DataToInformation. Full-file history and population coverage remain unverified; CompScript is defined by the current appendix as the average of the task measures.
routes.expected_period: The datasheet describes a 1995–2015 SEC filing construction target; the bounded sample does not establish the file coverage.

requirements.description: Author-prepared document identifiers and sample-membership indicators for the primary tests. This is an index of which filings are included; it is not the dependent-variable or control-variable dataset for the regressions. The README notes that NewsDelay is omitted and cannot be used to reconstruct Dissem without the proprietary Dow Jones News Archive data.

routes.description: The README identifies this file as the primary-test sample index. The bounded probe confirms accessionnumber, cik, filedate, formgroup and sample flags including sample_Dissem. Its one-row read does not establish full sample coverage and it contains no NewsDelay outcome field.

requirements.description: Underlying data needed for the reported Dissem/news-dissemination analysis. The packaged sample_Dissem field indicates sample membership only; the README expressly says the NewsDelay indicator is withheld and that Dissem cannot be reconstructed without the proprietary Dow Jones News Archive. Exact consumed fields and file format are not specified in this release.

routes.description: The authors report purchasing/downloading Dow Jones news archives for 2010–2015, but the data are not in this package and no current access, license or compatible delivery route is verified. A proprietary purchase is not treated as evidence of a current access barrier.

requirements.description: The measure-construction branch explicitly begins with SEC EDGAR filing-day archives from 1995–2015, then retains non-amended 10-K, 10-Q, 8-K and DEF 14A filings and extracts full filing metadata/content. This is a required raw input for the scoped measure-construction stage; the packaged final scores do not replace it for the raw-rebuild branch.

routes.description: The official SEC page says EDGAR indexes cover public filings from 1994Q3 onward, Feed provides tar/gzip archives for each filing day, indexes identify form/CIK/date/file, and paths link to complete disseminated filing text. Access is free subject to SEC fair-access rules (including a 10 requests/second limit and acceptable user-agent behavior). The author recipe describes ZIP archives, so archive-format handling must be aligned with the eventual supplied code. Exact day-by-day coverage and the expected HTML/header/binary/exhibit bytes still require validation; no files were acquired.

The documented local SEC and LM roots exist, but only directory metadata was inspected. The downloads/exhibits corpora are candidates; the cleaned 10-X corpus does not establish complete raw HTML, header, binary/exhibit or four-form coverage for 1995–2015. No recursive scan or content read was performed.

requirements.description: The valid-filing screen in the current measure-construction recipe requires a match in the CRSP/Compustat linking file to exclude duplicate/subsidiary filings. The exact source dataset, join keys, link-date validity rule and period coverage are not specified in the supplied workflow.

routes.description: The frozen catalog lists a CRSP/COMPUSTAT merged link-history table at this path. It is a candidate only: no bounded file read was made and the authors’ exact match fields and valid-link/date rules are unknown. No access or license claim is inferred from the catalog record.
routes.expected_period: Link history must support the 1995–2015 filing-construction window; exact effective-date rules are unresolved.

requirements.description: Additional data required by the complete main and validation analyses, excluding the separately tracked SEC filing corpus, CRSP/Compustat valid-filing linkage and Dow Jones Dissem input. The current documents name validation datasets and other sources, but the released files and sources do not map the full remaining empirical data contracts to each table/test: exact products, fields, identifiers, sample bounds, transformations, and joins remain unknown. Catalog matches are discovery candidates only.

routes.location: Frozen catalog candidates under ${ACCTREPL_SAS_ROOT} (including Thomson Reuters 13F holdings candidate TFN.S34; other exact products unresolved)
routes.description: The frozen catalog has a Thomson Reuters 13F holdings candidate, but no exact analysis product, field/history contract, bounded file read, or compatible author workflow is established for the remaining empirical inputs. Search misses for other source names are not evidence that access or files are absent.

issues.description: The datasheet states that conversion code is not supplied and documents a current sequence of SEC filing processing, heading/row-name post-processing, Python output combination, and an R combination/measure-construction stage. The package inventory has no standalone programs; its 64-line .Rhistory is an interactive, partial history with repeated path attempts, exploratory commands and a CSV selection/export fragment, not a complete entry point for those stages or the reported analyses. That fragment references docindidxFINAL2.csv and SCRIPTABILITY_DATA.csv.gz, which are not in the assigned package, while SCRIPTABILITY_DATA_FINAL.csv.gz is supplied as the author-prepared score file. I retain the history as code evidence but do not treat it as a clean runnable stage or make its historical inputs live dependencies absent author confirmation. The complete analysis entry points, their input/output map and dependency closure remain unresolved.

review_notes: One full_pipeline scope is retained. No analysis_only scope is supported: the packaged scriptability-score file and sample-membership index do not provide the missing complete main-analysis entry points and all outcome/control inputs.

The .Rhistory is code content but not a clean runnable workflow. It includes help/View calls, repeated local path attempts, package update/install commands, exploratory filters, and a partial CSV selection/export segment. It references docindidxFINAL2.csv and SCRIPTABILITY_DATA.csv.gz, neither of which is in this package. Those history-only inputs are not treated as current live requirements because the final author-prepared SCRIPTABILITY_DATA_FINAL.csv.gz is separately supplied; if the authors confirm that history-derived stage is required, its inputs and current script must be provided.

The selected full-pipeline scope includes the documented raw filing-construction branch, so the 1995–2015 four-form SEC corpus and CRSP/Compustat valid-filing linkage are explicit requirements. The packaged final score data do not close that raw-rebuild branch.

Official SEC documentation verifies a free public route to daily EDGAR archives and complete filing text, subject to fair-access rules. The verified route does not certify local coverage or the authors’ exact archive handling; local SEC/LM checks were root metadata only, with no content reads or recursive scans.

The frozen catalog’s CCMXPF_LINKTABLE and 13F entries are discovery candidates only. No bounded read or exact field/date compatibility was established, and catalog misses do not prove that a source or license is absent.

The September 2016 registered-report proposal is historical. Current Internet Appendix F records substantive and minor changes; proposed alternatives in the original proposal were not treated as current workflow dependencies.

The final-sample CSV is a document-membership index, not underlying dependent-variable data. The README specifically says NewsDelay is omitted and identifies the proprietary Dow Jones archive as necessary to reconstruct Dissem.

Software versions reflect this environment only. Author versions are unspecified; NLTK corpus and Aspell-list identity remain unverified, and data.table is absent but is only conditional on using the partial R history.
No author code, regressions, or full datasets were executed/read; no downloads, installations, or package edits were performed. Checks were bounded metadata/software inspections.
